method: Read-only source inspection of targeted implementation files and public configuration code. No environment files, credentials, private records, external requests or project-source writes were used. Identical normalized source hashes were compared for shared B2, review and analytics implementations after inspecting a representative implementation.
globalLimits: Implementation presence supports platform capabilities, not personal ownership of every implementation. Confirmed contribution scopes remain authoritative.
No inspected evidence establishes Google rankings, Top 1 positions, indexing outcomes, AI citations, traffic gains, conversion gains or performance savings.

No explicit GPTBot/OAI-SearchBot/ChatGPT-User/PerplexityBot or llms.txt implementation was found in the searched source/public files. Ordinary page metadata, structured data and crawl rules must not be described as proven AI crawler results.

No Payload CMS configuration/imports or Cloudflare R2 storage implementation was found in the inspected project source. Verified media storage uses Backblaze B2; CDN delivery remains deployment-configurable.
Google Places retrieval, first-party verified reviews and placeholder/fallback testimonials must be described separately. No review text, stars or counts were copied into portfolio evidence.
